timestamp_semantics: monotonic logical append time after Campaign199 terminal authority, complete skill read and bounded Campaign200 repository checks
purpose: Freeze a finite issuer-as-contractor construction and engineering project mobilization, execution, progress measurement, certification, variation, claim, retention, liquidated-damage, cash-realization, completion, handover and defects-liability lifecycle before source rows, project values, formulas, directions, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.bounded_search_scope: Campaign160 inventory and Campaign163-199 source-frontier metadata only
repository_evidence.major_contract_boundary: Campaign167 records the Eastmoney major-contract disclosure intensity branch as terminal. A tender, order win, award announcement, customer validation, signed contract or headline backlog cannot be relabelled as contractor execution quality.
repository_evidence.owned_asset_capex_boundary: Campaign178 freezes issuer-owned capital commitments, construction in progress, ready-for-use, capitalization, utilization and maintenance. Campaign200 is limited to the issuer acting as contractor for a customer's project; owner-side asset construction cannot substitute for certified contractual performance, variations, retention or final account.
repository_evidence.real_estate_boundary: Campaign185 freezes a property developer's land, permits, presales, collections and delivery obligations. A developer's own property phase or homebuyer handover cannot be mixed with an engineering contractor's customer-certified work, claim entitlement, retention and defects-liability release.
repository_evidence.operating_milestone_boundary: Campaign167 freezes discrete commissioning, approval and R&D milestones. A single start, completion or acceptance announcement does not preserve the full contractor project population, progress-measurement basis, rejected certifications, variations, disputes, delays and failed projects.
repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes customer and supplier concentration. A project owner, subcontractor or vendor may enter concentration denominators, but concentration does not identify work execution, certification, variation, claim, retention, payment or handover state.
repository_evidence.pricing_boundary: Campaign169 freezes bid prices, tariffs, fees, discounts and contract terms. Contract value or margin terms do not establish mobilization, measured work, certification, approved variations, claim settlement, retention release or defect closure.
repository_evidence.accounting_and_market_boundary: Contract assets, contract liabilities, unbilled receivables, revenue, margin, impairment, provisions, operating cash flow or security-price paths are accounting or market outcomes unless bound to stable project, role, obligation, certification, variation, claim, retention, completion and first-public histories.
repository_evidence.sector_scope_boundary: Applicable construction, engineering, EPC, specialist contractor and project-service issuers must be frozen point in time. Property developers, asset owners, equipment sellers and structurally inapplicable issuers may not be filled with zero or cross-sector ranked.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current project list, order book or completion schedule cannot be projected backward without award baseline, notice to proceed, mobilization, measurement, certification, variation, claim, delay, suspension, termination, payment, handover, defects, correction and first-public histories.
